Total token supply, minted entirely to a hard-coded address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
SafeMath addition helper with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction helper with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication helper with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division helper with division-by-zero require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when msg.sender equals the staged newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata and mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of a given account.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend guard.
ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens from 'from' to 'to' after debiting the spender allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets an allowance then calls receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function that forwards an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary token address.
External callback declared by ApproveAndCallFallBack and invoked by approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and callback arguments.

Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow.
External callback call to an arbitrary spender contract after the allowance write.
External call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract from the privileged transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during the Owned constructor, granting privileged control.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership state.
msg.sender is the mapping key for the debited balance in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key used to write the allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key used to debit the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance and is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the callback.
Constructor writes the caller address into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership assigns the staged address to newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privileged control.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the total supply value.
Constructor mints the entire supply to a hard-coded balance entry.
totalSupply reads the stored _totalSupply value.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] during its computation.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
transfer writes the updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
approve overwrites the allowance for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom mutates the nested allowed mapping for the spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the privileged owner address as the transfer recipient.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to an attacker-supplied token contract.
The fallback immediately executes revert().
safeAdd computes an addition that must be overflow-checked.
safeSub computes a subtraction that must be underflow-checked.
safeMul computes a multiplication that must be overflow-checked.
safeDiv computes a division that must be zero-checked.
